title: Upper Grades Math Teacher
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.


Job Description


WHY TEACH AT AVENUES?

Avenues | The World School prepares students for engaged global citizenship during a time of unprecedented complexity and accelerating change, combining language immersion, interdisciplinary learning, a global curriculum, and a culture of creativity and deep collaboration.


DEEP COLLABORATION, CONSTANT EVOLUTION

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams design learning experiences together. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.


SECONDARY DIVISION

The Middle and Upper Grades are where our ambitious goals for Avenues graduates, defined in our mission statement , are most comprehensively realized. While in grades 6-12, we prepare students for a globally connected, innovation-driven, and largely unknown future. Our students will be: accomplished in all the academic skills you would expect, at ease beyond their borders, and confident because they excel in a particular passion.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Avenues uses a problem-based mathematics pedagogy and curriculum. Math in Middle/Upper grades is taught through a student centered approach, where students discuss to find their solutions, continually reflect on mistakes and master mathematical concepts through working out problems together. Teachers facilitate discourse in class to guide students to deeper understanding of mathematics. You will also:

● Ensure that students achieve key learning outcomes, targeting instruction to address individual needs

● Build a learning atmosphere that leads students to feel part of a rigorous, dynamic, and joyful learning community

● Collaborate intensively with colleagues to continually deepen student learning

● Inspire trust and confidence among parents and families


Start date: July 2026


Qualifications


Math teachers at Avenues bring all or most of the following:

● A remarkable entrepreneurial drive, creativity and ability to bring new ideas to fruition

● Intellectual curiosity and humility, to reflect on and continually grow in teaching practice

● Strong content knowledge in math

● Pedagogy that engages all students in interesting, meaningful and challenging work

● Experience teaching math, with clear evidence of student learning and growth

● A strong sense of personal responsibility for the success of every student


Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Supply Chain Júnior / Pleno – Operações LATAM
description:

title: Analista de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento
description:
Quem somos?

A primeira unidade da AMAGGI, a Sementes Maggi, foi inaugurada em 1977 na cidade de São Miguel do Iguaçu, no Paraná. Dois anos depois, em 1979, tiveram início as atividades em Mato Grosso, com a aquisição de uma fazenda no município de Itiquira.


Desde então, a empresa tem ampliado suas unidades e áreas de negócios, expandindo a atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Com sede em Cuiabá (MT), é hoje a maior companhia brasileira na cadeia de grãos e fibras do país e está presente também na China, Argentina, Paraguai, Holanda, Noruega, Singapura e Suíça.


Além disso, desde 1997 contribui para o desenvolvimento local e humano nas comunidades onde atua, colocando-se como parceira no desenvolvimento sustentável dessas localidades por meio da Fundação André e Lucia Maggi.


Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um Analista em Desenvolvimento de Treinamento para atuar em nosso escritório na cidade de Sapezal, MT, em regime presencial. Este é um cargo de tempo integral que desempenhará um papel essencial no desenvolvimento e implementação de programas de treinamento e capacitação.


Atribuições:

  • Responsável pela análise e execução das atividades de apoio aos processos de Educação e Desenvolvimento Organizacional das Unidades;
  • Contribuir no levantamento das demandas de treinamento da unidade, bem como providenciar logística para treinamentos.
  • Auxiliar na preparação de material, relatórios e indicadores para subsidiar às áreas de RH Corporativas e gestores das Unidades.
  • Gestão de plataforma de educação corporativa.
  • Elaboração e controle do orçamento de treinamento.


Requisitos Necessários:

  • Graduação Completa em Psicologia, Pedagogia ou Administração;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens nas proximidades;
  • Vivência em processos de treinamento e desenvolvimento humano.


Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Apoio Pass
  • Dr. Amaggi - Telemedicina
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale-alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Auxílio Educação
  • Wellhub

  • Kit do Conhecimento


*Nossas oportunidades são abertas para todos os profissionais, sem distinção de raça, cor, gênero, idade, crença e deficiência (PCD)*

title: After Sales Service Specialist
description:
Company:

A high-tech enterprise founded in 2017 and headquartered in China. As a dedicated player in the global smart home cleaning sector, we provide comprehensive, one-stop product solutions to customers worldwide. We are now establishing our very first local service team in Brazil, and this is your chance to be a pioneer member!


The Role:

Based primarily at key client sites in major cities in Brazil, you will be the frontline technical expert for our robotic vacuum cleaners. You'll diagnose issues, perform on-site repairs, and act as the vital link between our customers and our HQ.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Diagnose and repair robotic vacuums at client locations, ensuring quality and efficiency.
  • Distinguish between user errors and genuine product defects to reduce unnecessary returns.
  • Handle simple hardware repairs (e.g., parts replacement) and report complex cases to HQ.
  • Maintain service records, manage spare parts inventory, and assist with technical documentation.
  • Provide feedback to our product and quality teams to help improve future models.


What We're Looking For:

  • 1+ year experience in consumer electronics repair (vacuum robots, small appliances preferred).
  • Familiarity with multimeters, soldering tools, and basic circuit diagnosis.
  • Basic software troubleshooting skills (firmware updates, app connectivity).
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills; ability to work independently.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English are essential.
  • Mandarin is a huge plus.


Why Join Us?

  • Pioneering Role: You'll help shape our local processes and team culture from the start.
  • Stability & Commitment: We are fully committed to the Brazilian market, with a clear goal to build a sustainable local presence.
  • Work-Life Balance: Manageable case volume with no urgent response required; flexible, independent work environment.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Gestão de Ativos
description:
No mundo, a ENGIE é um importante player na transição energética, com o propósito de acelerar jornada rumo a uma economia neutra em carbono. Presente em 30 países e com 98 mil colaboradores, o Grupo atua em toda a cadeia de valor da energia, da geração renovável e gás verde à infraestrutura e fornecimento.


No Brasil, a ENGIE , empresa líder em energia 100% renovável do país, atua em geração, comercialização e transmissão de energia elétrica, Operação, manutenção e transporte de gás , e soluções energéticas. A empresa possui cerca de 13 GW de capacidade instalada, provenientes de fontes renováveis e com baixas emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa (GEE), como usinas hidrelétricas, eólicas, solares e a biomassa.


A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG , a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.




Missão do Cargo


Atuar de forma estratégica e técnica na gestão do ciclo de vida dos ativos do gasoduto, garantindo sua integridade, confiabilidade e desempenho, por meio da aplicação integradade soluções de engenharia nas disciplinas de medição, automação, elétrica, equipamentos rotativos, compressores, proteção catódica, geotecnia e engenharia de integridade.

Assegurar a disponibilidade operacional, o cumprimento das normas técnicas e regulatórias, e o alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio, promovendo uma abordagem preventiva

e sustentável.



Responsabilidades Principais


  • Executar e apoiar tecnicamente as inspeções e avaliações de integridade dos equipamentos e dutos, realizando acompanhamento de campo, controle de relatórios e registros
  • técnicos, e garantindo o cumprimento das normas aplicáveis
  • Acompanhar a execução de reparos e adequações identificadas nas inspeções, verificando a conformidade técnica das intervenções com os códigos de projeto, normas
  • regulamentadoras e especificações internas.
  • Realizar análises técnicas de falhas e contribuir em estudos de melhoria contínua, aplicando metodologias como RCA, FMEA e RCM, e propondo soluções técnicas que reforcem
  • a confiabilidade dos ativos
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos técnicos e instruções de trabalho, assegurando alinhamento com os padrões corporativos e oferecendo suporte técnico ao time de manutenção
  • e inspeção.
  • Monitorar a condição e a funcionalidade dos dispositivos de proteção mecânica, como válvulas de alívio e sistemas contra sobrepressão, realizando inspeções técnicas e
  • mantendo atualizada a documentação correspondente.
  • Dar suporte técnico à gestão de mudanças e à resposta a emergências, participando do desenvolvimento de MoCs e colaborando em investigações de falhas e incidentes
  • envolvendo sistemas pressurizados.
  • Disseminar boas práticas de confiabilidade e apoiar auditorias técnicas, contribuindo para a formação técnica das equipes, participando de comitês quando solicitado e
  • promovendo a padronização dos processos de engenharia.
  • Coletar, analisar e acompanhar indicadores de confiabilidade e integridade, colaborando com a área corporativa no desenvolvimento de KPIs e estudos estatísticos que
  • embasem a tomada de decisão técnica.

  • Desejável: Especialização (Pós-Graduação/MBA);

Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de Porto Alegre - RS.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.


What You'll Do


  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets.
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta.
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry.
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience.
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.


What We Need From You


  • Have excellent business negotiation and market development capabilities, be loyal to business goals, have insight into the needs of users, and be brave to embrace challenges.
  • Have basic data analysis skills and master office software applications. Experience in working with charts/graphs is required.
  • Integrity, honesty and resilience. Passionate about work and possessing a strong team spirit.
  • English and Portuguese can be used as working languages.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.


As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.


At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.


Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Lead Java Developer
description:
About Phi Partners

Phi Partners is the a market leader for capital markets technology services providing technology & quant services, solutions, and expertise to buy-side and sell-side financial institutions including some of the world’s largest investment banks, hedge funds and asset management firms. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in London, Phi has a presence in all major continents. Our niche focus on Front Office Technology has been a differentiator and gateway into the world’s best financial institutions.


About Phi Partners Brazil

Phi Partners has nearshore Centres-of-Excellence which are specialized in respective ‘Lines of Business’ (LoBs). Our latest São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence, houses our Quant, Front Office & Risk Technology Services (FORTS) & Murex teams. The São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence was opened with the goal to strengthened Phi's current relationship with our North America clients, as well with global clients with presence in São Paulo. Joining us means diving into truly groundbreaking work, pushing the limits of what modern technology can deliver while solving high-impact challenges for top-tier clients. You’ll build cutting-edge solutions for the world’s largest Investment Banks, leading Asset Managers, and market-defining Hedge Funds, working on projects where innovation is not an extra, but a fundamental expectation in everything we deliver.


About The FORTS Practice

Phi Partners is one of the largest consultancies specializing FORTS, with a dedicated team of over 175 consultants spread across multiple locations. Our team is distinguished by deep expertise in front-office and risk technology solutions, empowering top-tier financial institutions to optimize their trading and risk management capabilities.


At Phi Partners, we are committed to a collaborative, high-performance culture where professionals work together to deliver complex front-office solutions to elite clients. We specialize in the end-to-end implementation of front-office and risk platforms, from initial requirements gathering to post-go-live support, ensuring that our clients are fully supported throughout the platform lifecycle. We focus on custom development and configuration, creating solutions that address unique client needs and regulatory requirements in real-time trading and risk management.


Additionally, we conduct extensive training and knowledge transfer sessions, ensuring client teams are equipped to maximize the value of their technology investments.


Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop robust, scalable applications supporting E-Trading systems across asset classes

• Work with trading, operations, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver effective solutions

• Apply sound design and architecture principles, using data structures and algorithms for performance

• Stay current with technologies and industry trends, particularly within algorithmic and e-Trading platforms

• Analyze and resolve system bottlenecks, performance issues, and application bugs


The Ideal candidate

• Hands-on experience with Java - including experience in electronic trading platforms

• Experience with unit testing and CI/CD pipelines

• Knowledge on one of the following: Equities; FX; Rates; Credit; and Derivatives is a plus

• In-depth knowledge of multithreading, memory management, and low-latency systems

• Solid understanding of design & architecture principles, common data structures and algorithms complexity

• Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, tools like Intellij, JIRA and Confluence and version control in Git

• Fluency in English (both written and spoken)


Why should you join Phi Parnters

Join us as we build the next-generation eTrading team, an ambitious, fast-growing group delivering world-class, complex, and genuinely exciting projects to major financial institutions around the globe. We’re in a pivotal expansion phase, working with leading-edge technologies and giving you the chance to shape our strategy, influence key architectural decisions, and deploy solutions that truly impact global Capital Markets. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a world-leading Capital Markets Technology Consultancy while working alongside one of the strongest banking organizations in the industry.

title: PESSOA ANALISTA DA GARANTIA DA QUALIDADE PLENO

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar e revisar documentações com impacto em BPF (Boas Práticas de Fabricação) e BPL (Boas Práticas de Laboratório), através das ferramentas disponibilizadas na área para a Gestão de Documentos fornecidos pela empresa para atender as normas e regulamentações vigentes.
  • Participar da execução de treinamentos internos / Integração de Novos Funcionários / Boas Práticas de Fabricação/Laboratório e reciclagem para garantir que os colaboradores internos estejam adequadamente capacitados quanto às práticas e políticas da qualidade.

  • Participar de discussões e investigações detalhadas de não conformidades, contribuindo para identificação de causas raiz e implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas (CAPA) para evitar recorrências.
  • Preparar e participar de inspeções regulatórias, garantindo que os sistemas da qualidade estejam em conformidade com as normas estabelecidas pelos órgãos reguladores.
  • Planejar e conduzir auditorias internas através do cumprimento do Cronograma anual de Auditorias para garantir que os processos internos estejam em conformidade com os padrões de qualidade, procedimentos operacionais padrão (POPs) e regulamentações aplicáveis.
  • Atender e dar suporte às necessidade e demandas oriundas das áreas internas, no que tange às questões de Qualidade, atuando como facilitador dos processos envolvidos em toda a cadeia produtiva / desenvolvimento de produtos, através da atuação consultiva, para auxiliar no cumprimento das normas regulatórias para a atividade.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Conhecimento em planejamento, condução e elaboração de relatórios de auditorias internas para avaliação de conformidade com padrões de qualidade e identificação de oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Conhecimento em investigação de não conformidades, utilizando ferramentas como 5 Porquês, FMEA (Análise de Modo e Efeito de Falha) e Diagrama de Ishikawa para identificação de causas raiz e definição de ações corretivas;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e sistemas de gerenciamento da qualidade, soluções de documentação eletrônica, treinamento, controle de mudanças e softwares de análise de dados;

title: Project Manager
description:
Sobre a Vaga  

Como Project Manager , você dará suporte ao time de Gestão de Projetos na execução e acompanhamento das iniciativas, garantindo que as entregas sejam feitas com qualidade e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos. 

Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido , com atividades realizadas de forma remota e encontros presenciais uma vez por semana na cidade de São Paulo . 


Responsabilidades  

  • Gerenciar o fluxo interno de projetos, garantindo a distribuição eficiente das demandas entre as equipes. 
  • Acompanhar prazos, prioridades e recursos, assegurando entregas dentro do cronograma. 
  • Atuar como ponto de contato entre equipes criativas, planejamento e desenvolvimento para alinhar briefings, prazos e entregáveis. 
  • Controlar a carga de trabalho da equipe, evitando gargalos e otimizando a produtividade. 
  • Garantir que todas as entregas atendam aos padrões de qualidade da agência, incluindo testes via BrowserStack . 
  • Realizar QA (Quality Assurance) nos projetos para garantir funcionalidade e qualidade das entregas. 
  • Gerenciar os jobs por meio da ferramenta Accelo , garantindo que todas as demandas sejam organizadas e rastreadas corretamente. 
  • Acompanhar e garantir o correto preenchimento dos timesheets  da equipe, garantindo controle eficiente das horas trabalhadas em cada projeto. 
  • Controlar e administrar fornecedores externos, incluindo negociação, acompanhamento de entregas e qualidade dos serviços prestados. 
  • Gerenciar pagamentos e garantir a correta execução dos contratos de prestadores de serviços. 
  • Manter comunicação clara e objetiva, especialmente em inglês, com a equipe, clientes e stakeholders. 
  • Organizar reuniões, documentar atas e acompanhar o cumprimento de ações definidas. 
  • Utilizar ferramentas de gestão de projetos e controle de tempo, como Accelo, Trello ou similares . 
  • Trabalhar de forma organizada, com atenção aos detalhes e proatividade na resolução de problemas. 
  • Lidar com múltiplas tarefas e prazos simultaneamente, garantindo eficiência na execução dos projetos. 


Requisitos  

✅ Experiência prévia na função de Tráfego ou Gestão de Projetos em agência de publicidade. 

✅ Fluência em inglês (escrita e conversação). 

✅ Habilidade para lidar com múltiplos projetos simultaneamente. 

✅ Organização e proatividade para gerenciar cronogramas e prazos. 

✅  Experiência no gerenciamento de timesheets e controle de horas da equipe. 

✅ Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Accelo e Trello é um diferencial). 

✅ Perfil comunicativo, estratégico, organizado, atento aos detalhes e orientado a soluções. 

✅ Disponibilidade para encontros presenciais uma vez por semana em São Paulo . 


Diferenciais  

➕ Conhecimento em marketing digital, estratégia e desenvolvimento. 

➕ Experiência com clientes internacionais. 

➕ Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis. 


Benefícios  

 Modelo de trabalho híbrido (remoto + presencial 1x por semana em São Paulo). 

 Remuneração compatível com o mercado. 

  •  Oportunidade de crescimento em uma agência dinâmica e inovadora.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
About Us

For over 25 years, Yuwell Medical has been dedicated to advancing healthcare worldwide. Founded in 1998, we became the first privately owned medical device company listed on a Mainland Chinese stock exchange in 2008. Today, we operate 12 R&D centers and 9 production bases across Asia, Europe, and beyond, serving more than 300,000 medical institutions in 131 countries and improving the lives of over 300 million households.


In Brazil, we are growing rapidly. Currently focused on import and distribution, we will expanding into marketplace and e-commerce operations. To support this journey, we are seeking a Senior Finance Analyst (Import/Distruibution or E-commerce Sales) who will play a key role in ensuring smooth financial routines, import and distribution/E-commerce processes, accurate documentation, and effective collaboration with our outsourced accounting and finance BPO.


What You'll Do


Invoicing & Documentation

- Issue electronic invoices (NF-e) via ERP with precision and timeliness.

- Organize and send XML files and related documents (returns, cancellations, correction letters) to the BPO.

- Ensure compliance and accuracy in import/export documentation.


Accounts Payable & Receivable

- Manage payment processing, scheduling, and execution through banks/Internet Banking.

- Verify documents and maintain clear evidence of transactions.

- Support financial flows related to importation and sales to nacional customer


Expense support

- Track operational expenses and reimbursements process.

- Ensure complete, traceable documentation for BPO reporting.


Administrative Support

- Collaborate with commercial, operations, logistics, and e-commerce teams to gather invoicing information.


Process Improvement & Compliance

- Suggest improvements to reduce rework and risks (checklists, deadlines, standardization).

- Act as the main support point for BPO auditors, ensuring timely submission of all required documents.

- Strengthen compliance in import/export routines, aligning with tax, customs, and regulatory requirements.


What We're Looking For

- Experience in financial operations related to import and distribution of products (or import and sales in e-comerce platform)

- Background in finance for both offline distribution and online channels (marketplace/e-commerce).

- Solid experience in administrative-financial routines, including invoicing (NF-e), accounts payable, and receivable.

- Hands-on knowledge of NF-e and XML handling.

- ERP experience (Olist/Tiny, Bling or similar).

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize deadlines.

- Basic understanding of tax concepts (CFOP, CST/CSOSN, ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS) for verification and BPO interface.

- Clear communication skills to act as the focal point with the BPO.

- Intermediate Excel/Google Sheets proficiency.

- Intermediate English preferred.

- Experience in BPO collaboration is a plus.


Why Join Us

- Be part of a global leader in healthcare technology with a strong mission to improve lives.

- Work in a fast-growing Brazilian operation with opportunities to shape processes and contribute to expansion.

- Collaborate with international teams and gain exposure to global business practices.

- Grow your career in a company that values innovation, professionalism, and continuous improvement.


If you are detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to contribute to a dynamic healthcare company, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Bolsista Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Natosafe - Pesquisa de IA Generativa
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .


Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Natosafe é pioneira em biometria infantil, comprometidos em preencher a lacuna existente na proteção, segurança e garantia de identidade para as crianças. Durante anos, essa questão crucial tem sido negligenciada, deixando os mais vulneráveis expostos a riscos e sem o reconhecimento adequado. Através da coleta de biometria desde os primeiros momentos de vida, asseguramos que cada criança tenha sua identidade e cidadania protegidas, contribuindo para um futuro mais seguro e inclusivo, onde todas as crianças sejam vistas, cuidadas, respeitadas e tenham pleno acesso aos seus direitos desde o nascimento.

O projeto visa melhorar a qualificação de imagens e a extração de características das impressões digitais, além de permitir o reconhecimento de indivíduos ao longo do tempo, considerando as variações naturais nas características digitais.


Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Pesquisa da IA Generativa voltada à imagens de impressões digitais de crianças



Principais Atividades:

  • Pesquisa Avançada: Conduzir pesquisas inovadoras em computação quântica aplicadas a sistemas de segurança digital e autenticação biométrica. Explorar novos algoritmos quânticos e suas aplicações práticas na criação de soluções mais robustas e seguras.
  • Desenvolvimento de Soluções: Desenvolver novos modelos de autenticação que utilizem a computação quântica para criar sistemas mais seguros, adaptáveis e imunes a ataques sofisticados.
  • Disseminação do Conhecimento: Participar de conferências e eventos acadêmicos, apresentando descobertas, novas teorias e inovações tecnológicas. Contribuir para a construção de um ecossistema de pesquisa em computação quântica no Brasil e globalmente.
  • Apoio à Implementação de Tecnologias: Auxiliar na transição das descobertas teóricas para a prática, facilitando a implementação de novas tecnologias de segurança digital em ambientes reais, tanto no contexto acadêmico quanto em colaboração com empresas de tecnologia.


Conhecimento necessário:

  • Visão Computacional Avançada
  • Processamento de Sinais e Imagens Digitais
  • Aplicação de redes neurais convolucionais (CNNs)
  • Projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação
  • Programação em Python e C++ com uso de bibliotecas como OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch
  • Atuação com frameworks para prototipagem rápida em visão computacional.
  • Inglês Avançado.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Programação Quântica: Proficiência em linguagens de programação voltadas para computação quântica, como Qiskit (IBM) e Cirq (Google), além de Python e outras linguagens tradicionais. A capacidade de programar em ambientes quânticos será fundamental para o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e seguras.
  • Algoritmos Quânticos: Conhecimento avançado na criação, implementação e otimização de algoritmos quânticos, com foco em criptografia quântica e autenticação biométrica. Deve possuir a capacidade de aplicar teoria quântica para criar soluções robustas de segurança digital.
  • Criptografia Quântica: Expertise em criptografia quântica para desenvolver sistemas imunes a ataques futuros, utilizando princípios da física quântica para garantir a segurança da verificação de identidade.
  • Desejável: Conhecimento de algoritmos biométricos e sistemas de verificação de identidade, além de familiaridade com técnicas de deep learning e machine learning aplicadas à biometria.


Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Híbrido

Local: Curitiba/PR

Soft Skills : Trabalho em equipe; Autonomia; Organização.

title: Senior Industrial Engineer
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. 2.5+ years of experience in warehouse IE, layout design or process improvement.

3.Familiarity with IE tools such as time studies, motion studies and capacity balancing.

4.Proficient in AutoCAD/Visio for layout design and Excel/Power BI for data analysis and reporting.

5.Strong numerical analysis and ROI modeling skills.

6.Excellent cross-department communication and coordination skills.

7.Good command of spoken and written English.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

Atividades a serem desenvolvidas

title: Software Developer
description:
The Company:

Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Hexagon’s Mining division solves surface and underground mine challenges with proven technologies for planning, operations, and safety.


Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 24,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 5.5bn USD. Learn more at hexagon.com and follow us @HexagonAB.

Purpose of Position:


Hexagon Mining develops intelligent collision avoidance systems for large vehicles used mainly in open-pit mining. Its products integrate satellite navigation, digital radio, multiple sensors and actuation systems as well as sophisticated algorithms to reliably predict dangerous scenarios and prevent accidents. It employs approx. 100 R&D staff in several attractive international locations. The software developer will join the team to develop this solution.


Major Areas of Responsibility:

  • Design, develop and support our server backend services and client tools used for the current and next generation of our collision avoidance and safety system.
  • Collaborate closely with the hardware, firmware, and backend service development teams to realize new integrated solutions.
  • Assist the product-introduction team and gain first-hand experience with our products.
  • Bring in innovative ideas for further development.


Knowledge and Experience - Required:

  • Bachelor or master’s in software engineering, Electrical Engineering or similar field.
  • Experience in C and C++ on embedded or Linux systems.
  • MQTT and other IoT related protocols, networking technologies in general, and related network security aspects.
  • Very good knowledge of English.
  • Team oriented and able to work independently.
  • Positive working attitude and good common sense to understand business requirements.
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally.


Knowledge and Experience - Desired:

  • Web technologies, React.js.
  • Knowledge of OpenWRT and Yocto
  • Knowledge of additional high-level language, e.g., Python, C#.
  • Development and/or maintenance of software for safety-critical, automotive, real-time or control systems
  • Development of localization, navigation, or perception systems based on technologies such as GNSS, radio, UWB, automotive radars, and IMUs.
  • Implementation of CAN, Ethernet, I2C, RS-232 or SPI-based drivers.
  • Functional Safety.
  • Experience with Test-Driven Design, Continuous Integration, and agile development processes (e.g., Scrum).


Travel:

  • 5-10%


Benefits:

  • Health plan
  • Comprehensive health program (psychological, nutritional, legal, financial, and social assistance)
  • Wellhub (Gym)
  • Life insurance
  • Meal/food allowance
  • Dental plan
  • Private pension plan


You will work on products that could revolutionize the mining industry in the next 5 years. Your colleagues consist of highly qualified and open-minded engineers from all over the world. Beside the developer career you will have the opportunity to develop into multiple directions like project management, product management, customer support and sales.


Join our team as a software developer and make a significant impact on our clients' digital transformation initiatives. We offer a stimulating work environment, competitive compensation package, and opportunities for professional growth. Apply now and help shape the future of Hexagon’s technology solutions.


Hexagon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against any job applicant based on protected characteristics.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Assessor de Investimentos
description:
TIR está contratando Assessor de Investimentos. | Venha fazer parte de uma assessoria construída com método, governança e visão de longo prazo.


A maioria dos escritórios fala sobre crescimento. Poucos explicam como ele é medido. Falam sobre partnership, mas não mostram a matemática. Falam sobre suporte, mas entregam direcionamento, não resolução.


O assessor que já amadureceu sabe identificar quando o problema não é o mercado, nem o cliente.

É a estrutura interna.

E você sabe disso melhor do que ninguém.


Você construiu uma carteira com esforço real. Passou por ciclos difíceis, manteve clientes em momentos de pânico, aprendeu a ler o mercado quando ele não colaborava. Desenvolveu um nível técnico que poucos têm.

E mesmo assim, quando você precisa de uma resposta operacional, ela não vem. Quando você quer entender sua trajetória na casa, ninguém sabe explicar com clareza. Quando você leva um problema, recebe um caminho para resolver sozinho.


Em algum momento, você parou e pensou:


Será que o problema sou eu?

Não é você.


Repasse pouco transparente. Partnership com métricas que mudam conforme conveniência. Plano de carreira que existe no discurso e some na prática. Middle que orienta o caminho, mas não assume responsabilidade por resolver. Especialistas que aparecem no pitch e somem na execução. Oferta empurrada sem estratégia, o produto da vez, independente do que o cliente realmente precisa.


Isso não é azar. É modelo.

E modelo é escolha.


A TIR nasceu da recusa em operar nesse modelo.


Somos uma assessoria de investimentos fundada por profissionais que atuaram por décadas no sistema financeiro tradicional e decidiram construir uma estrutura diferente. Conhecemos o modelo por dentro. Entendemos seus incentivos, seus limites e seus conflitos. E escolhemos evoluir a lógica.


Aqui, crescimento tem critério objetivo . Partnership tem régua matemática e documentada. Suporte técnico acompanha carteira e estratégia, não apenas a oferta do mês. Middle resolve, não redireciona. Plano de carreira não é conversa de corredor, é estrutura com marcos claros desde o primeiro dia.


Nossa remuneração se adapta à estratégia do cliente, e não o contrário. Transparência não é discurso. É arquitetura.

Para assessores e parceiros estratégicos, a TIR representa governança real, modelo societário estruturado, clareza de métricas e ambiente de longo prazo.


E algo que poucos escritórios admitem oferecer: você será tratado como profissional, não como número de AUC.

Não buscamos quem está desesperado para sair.


Buscamos profissionais que valorizam estrutura antes de produto, clareza antes de promessa e responsabilidade antes de performance de curto prazo. Que perceberam que o teto onde estão não é do mercado.

É da estrutura.


Se o seu nível técnico já ultrapassou o ambiente onde você opera, essa percepção não vai embora. Ela só aumenta.

Estamos em expansão e abrindo espaço para assessores, de todos os níveis de experiência, que queiram construir algo sólido dentro de uma casa que respeita o seu trabalho.


Construímos patrimônio com método.

Construímos relações com governança.

Construímos reputação no longo prazo.


Se você quer conversar sobre arquitetura real de crescimento, me escreva no privado.

Sem formulário.

Sem discurso pronto.

Sem promessa vazia.


Uma conversa direta. Estratégica. Confidencial.


Porque, antes de decidir para onde ir, você precisa ter clareza sobre onde quer construir.


Se a sua ambição é estrutural, a conversa é agora.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
The Company:

Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Hexagon’s Mining division solves surface and underground mine challenges with proven technologies for planning, operations, and safety.


Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 24,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 5.5bn USD. Learn more at hexagon.com and follow us @HexagonAB.

Purpose of Position:


The DevOps Engineer will play a key role in the automation of deployment, integration, and testing for exciting mining projects. They will work with the development, support, and quality assurance teams to implement processes by which projects can be produced at scale and tested and distributed automatically. They will assist teams working on both hardware and software projects with the goal of increasing both team productivity and product quality.


Major Areas of Responsibility:

  • Implement automated Continous Integration and Continous Deployment for both hardware and software based projects
  • Implement test automation for both hardware and software based projects
  • Help with development and deployment of simulation infrastructure for testing purposes
  • Support hardware and software teams with DevOps responsibilities


Knowledge and Experience - Required:

  • Bachelor or master’s in Computer Science, Software Development, Electronics, or equivalent
  • Strong knowledge of Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment and DevOps principles
  • Knowledge of test automation principles
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes
  • Development skills using a language such as C++, Java, or .NET
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation tools such as Linux Bash, PowerShell and Python
  • Knowledge of Agile development methodologies is required.


Knowledge and Experience - Desired:

  • Knowledge of Atlassian Bamboo a plus
  • Experience with containerization and deployment using Kubernetes and Docker a plus
  • Relevant certifications in cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP are a plus.
  • Knowledge of Cybersecurity industry standards such as NIST or CIS is a plus
  • Relevant certifications in Cybersecurity are a plus.


Travel:

  • No travel is required.


Benefits:

  • Health plan
  • Comprehensive health program (psychological, nutritional, legal, financial, and social assistance)
  • Wellhub (Gym)
  • Life insurance
  • Meal/food allowance
  • Dental plan
  • Private pension plan


Additional Information:

  • Fluent English (written and verbal) is a prerequisite.
  • Salary commensurate with experience and work location.


You will work on products that could revolutionize the mining industry in the next 5 years. Your colleagues consist of highly qualified and open-minded engineers from all over the world. Beside the developer career you will have the opportunity to develop into multiple directions.


Join our team as a DevOps engineer and make a significant impact on our clients' digital transformation initiatives. We offer a stimulating work environment, competitive compensation package, and opportunities for professional growth. Apply now and help shape the future of Hexagon’s technology solutions.


Hexagon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against any job applicant based on protected characteristic.

title: Senior developer
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior Developer


  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?



Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location. It is necessary to live near the city.



Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

In this role, you will work within a scrum team to bring the designs and ideas to life for new or improved applications. This work will support a mix of internal and external clients.

You will start your day on a scrum call to prioritize and track work. Within the team you work on, you will choose user stories to work within a sprint cycle. You will spend most of your day developing and testing your code.


To thrive in this development career, you'll need to have the following skills:


Front-End: HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, Stencil, RxJS, Flutter (bonus)

Back-End : Node.js, Express/Fastify, REST/GraphQL

Data/Storage : MongoDB, SQL, Redis, S3

Cloud/DevOps : AWS ECS, Lambda, CDN/CloudFront, Git, Jenkins, Docker



TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • You'll have a Bachelor's degree OR equivalent.
  • Advanced English



Knowledge on payroll and/or accounting processes is desirable to understand what’s being done and how your work affects the users. Like our best developers, you are an enthusiastic creator eager to learn and take on stretch assignments. You strive to learn new technologies and find ways to incorporate what you learn into building your products.

As a Senior Developer, you will work closely with your team to lead and guide projects to success. You'll have a hands-on role designing, developing, debugging, and deploying software solutions where you can leverage your expertise with code complexities. You'll also serve as a mentor to the junior developers. In the senior role, you will balance the assigning of user stories through prioritization and consideration of the technical interests of each developer on the team. As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry. Pace should not scare you. We still find time for a healthy dose of fun.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • You'll start each day with a scrum, working in a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities while choosing user stories to complete. You will also participate in other agile ceremonies, including scheduled sprint demos, where you will present your work to up to a large group of stakeholders.
  • Working in there-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and coding standards. Most of your daily schedule will be software development, but you will also test your code before submitting it to QA for final testing. You won't just focus on development in this role. You will also be responsible for testing and deployment.
  • You will attend meetings to actively collaborate with other developers to share ideas or show what you've learned. An eagerness to learn will help you keep up with ever-changing technologies and maintain the ability to create the best tools for our clients.
  • You're working on products currently in use. Those who report to you will act as a point of contact for one day/week, supporting your clients for any urgent issues requiring resolution. You may also have this responsibility. If so, you'll start those days with your regular work activity but will have to switch gears to a support role as needed throughout your assigned support day.



YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.



Like what you see? Apply now!


*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até três vezes na semana.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Missão do cargo

Garantir a operação eficiente do delivery, assegurando que os pedidos sejam expedidos e entregues dentro do prazo, com organização, padrão, boa comunicação entre setores e máxima qualidade na experiência do cliente.


Responsabilidades


Operação e expedição

  • Supervisionar toda a operação de delivery durante o turno, garantindo fluidez, organização e cumprimento dos processos.
  • Acompanhar o fluxo dos pedidos desde a saída da produção até a entrega ao cliente.
  • Garantir que os pedidos sejam conferidos corretamente antes da expedição, evitando faltas, trocas, erros de montagem e falhas de embalagem.
  • Organizar a expedição por prioridade, tempo de preparo, rota e prazo de entrega.
  • Atuar rapidamente em momentos de pico, redistribuindo demandas e ajustando a operação para evitar atrasos.
  • Monitorar pedidos em andamento e agir preventivamente diante de gargalos ou riscos de atraso.


Entregas e logística

  • Coordenar a operação dos entregadores, garantindo boa distribuição das corridas e melhor aproveitamento da equipe disponível.
  • Acompanhar tempos de saída, entrega, retorno e o desempenho da frota ou dos entregadores parceiros.
  • Garantir que os entregadores sigam os padrões definidos pela empresa em relação à apresentação, postura, cuidado com os pedidos e cumprimento das orientações.
  • Apoiar a definição e melhoria das rotas, zonas de atendimento e lógica de despacho.
  • Resolver ocorrências de entrega com agilidade, buscando a melhor solução para a operação e para o cliente.


Controle e qualidade

  • Garantir o cumprimento dos padrões de embalagem, conferência, despacho e entrega.
  • Monitorar indicadores operacionais do delivery, como tempo de produção, tempo de despacho, tempo total de entrega, taxa de atraso, taxa de erro e índice de reclamações.
  • Registrar e acompanhar falhas operacionais, identificando causa e propondo ações corretivas.
  • Apoiar o controle de materiais da expedição, como sacolas, embalagens, molhos, guardanapos, hashis, lacres e demais itens de envio.
  • Sinalizar melhorias de processo para aumentar eficiência, reduzir erros e melhorar a experiência final do cliente.


Liderança e alinhamento de equipe

  • Liderar a equipe de expedição e entregadores no turno, garantindo disciplina, agilidade e cumprimento de padrão.
  • Distribuir funções e acompanhar a execução da equipe conforme o volume operacional do dia.
  • Aplicar treinamentos práticos e reforços de rotina para manter o time alinhado.
  • Realizar feedbacks individuais e coletivos com foco em desempenho, postura e melhoria contínua.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre cozinha, atendimento e entrega, reduzindo ruídos entre setores.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência mínima de 1 a 2 anos em operação de delivery, logística, expedição ou supervisão operacional.
  • Vivência com rotina de alto volume, agilidade operacional e resolução de problemas em tempo real.
  • Capacidade de liderança, organização e tomada de decisão sob pressão.
  • Boa comunicação para lidar com cozinha, atendimento, entregadores e clientes em situações de ocorrência.
  • Disciplina para acompanhar processos, indicadores e padrões operacionais.


Diferenciais

Gerenciar, manter e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes on-premise (OpenShift) e cloud (GCP GKE), monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.

title: SAP Senior Automation Test Lead
description:
SAP Senior Automation Test Lead


Mars is a family-owned business with over $50 billion in global sales, producing iconic brands like M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, and more. We operate in 80+ countries and are guided by our Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. Join our 150,000 Associates in creating the world we want tomorrow.

As we work to transform and optimize Mars, a new program has been mobilized by the Mars leadership team. The program is focused on the design and implementation of SAP S/4HANA in Mars across Segments (Petcare, Corporate, Snacking & Food). Much more than a simple “Lift and Shift,” this program will undertake a major process simplification and harmonization scope as we digitally transform our business.

The program will focus primarily on eight mega process areas: Finance, Source to Pay (procurement and vendor mgmt.), Plan to Fulfill (manufacturing and distribution), Lead to Cash (order processing and payment), Governance, Engage to Consume (marketing), Idea to Market (R&D), and Recruit to Retire (HR). This program requires a Technology and Transformation Team for delivering the technical foundations and operational readiness of the S/4HANA Transformation.


As part of this transformation, a new role has been created for a Senior Automation Test Lead. This role will be responsible for defining the automation vision, frameworks, and best practices to ensure high-quality, efficiencies, and scalable testing across complex enterprise landscapes.


What are we looking for?

  • Have an IT background with at least 5 years of experience in ERP/SAP Development, Implementation or Transformation projects in a coordinating role
  • Have profound knowledge of testing management test processes and standards
  • Experience in building automation capabilities which is scalable across multiple landscapes.
  • Own and drive test and automation strategies.
  • Excellent understanding of S/4HANA product roadmap
  • Be very well organized with experience in effectively setting deadlines, and assigning responsibilities followed by monitoring, summarizing data, and communicating across various stakeholder groups ensuring clear ownership is established for all activities
  • You need to have attention to detail and coordinate with Test Factory and external partners.


What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Live and exemplify the Five Principles of Mars, Inc. within self and team.
  • Strategic Leadership & Governance: Define, develop, and own the enterprise-wide automation testing strategy aligned with the SAP S/4HANA transformation roadmap and satellite system integrations. Establish governance frameworks, standards, and policies for automation testing across multiple teams and vendors. Ensure automation testing objectives align with business priorities, compliance requirements, and overall quality goals. Lead cross-functional collaboration to integrate automation testing seamlessly into the development lifecycle and continuous delivery pipelines.
  • Reporting & Analysis: Prepare and present test reports and analysis to stakeholders, providing insights into the quality of the SAP Landscape. Ensure integration of automation testing tools and results into Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (Deployment) pipelines and reporting frameworks
  • Tools: Experience in testing tools (Tricentis NeoLoad, JIRA, SNOW, eCATT, SAP Solution Manager, AzureDevOps, Cloud ALM or equivalent such as HP/MF ALM) for test management.


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.


Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.
